value.answer: Mostly, yes. For most healthy adults, short-term use is generally considered safe. The usual side effects are drowsiness, headache or dizziness, so don't drive or do anything risky after taking it. It can interact with some medicines, like blood thinners, sedatives or diabetes meds, so if you take anything regularly, check with a pharmacist first. Longer-term use is less studied, so a doctor is the one to ask about that.
